web_fixture.title: Webhook retry schedule - Sablehook guides
web_fixture.snippet: How Sablehook spaces delivery attempts for events that do not succeed on the first try.
web_fixture.content:
# Webhook retry schedule

Sablehook guides, updated 2025-10-08.

A delivery counts as failed when the receiver does not return an HTTP 2xx response within 10 seconds. Sablehook makes up to 3 delivery attempts for each event, spacing them 30 seconds apart. After the third failed attempt the delivery is marked exhausted and no further attempts are made.

Retries are not billed separately; every attempt is covered by the event's delivery charge.

web_fixture.title: Delivery policy - Sablehook reference
web_fixture.snippet: Attempt counts and backoff windows for webhook delivery, revised in the 2026 platform update.
web_fixture.content:
# Delivery policy

Sablehook reference, revised 2026-08-19.

Sablehook makes up to 6 delivery attempts for each event, spacing them 1, 5, 25, 125 and 625 seconds apart. A delivery that fails on the sixth attempt is marked exhausted and no further attempts are made.

This policy replaces the 3-attempt schedule published on 2025-10-08, which no longer applies.
